// Token kinds.
const (

	tkNum
	tkIdent
	tkPlus
	tkMinus
	tkStar
	tkSlash
	tkPercent
	tkCaret
	tkLParen
	tkRParen
	tkComma
	tkQuestion
	tkColon
	tkLt
	tkLe
	tkGt
	tkGe
	tkEq
	tkNe
	tkAnd
	tkOr
	tkNot
)

type token struct {
	kind int
	text string // literal text of the token in the source
	pos  int    // 0-based byte offset of the token in the source
	val  float64
}

func isDigit(c byte) bool { return c >= '0' && c <= '9' }
func isIdentStart(c byte) bool {
	return c == '_' || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z')
}
func isIdentPart(c byte) bool { return isIdentStart(c) || isDigit(c) }

func lex(src string) ([]token, error) {
	toks := make([]token, 0, 16)
	i := 0
	for i < len(src) {
		c := src[i]
		switch {
		case c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n':
			i++
		case isIdentStart(c):
			start := i
			for i < len(src) && isIdentPart(src[i]) {
				i++
			}
			toks = append(toks, token{kind: tkIdent, text: src[start:i], pos: start})
		case isDigit(c) || (c == '.' && i+1 < len(src) && isDigit(src[i+1])):
			start := i
			j := i
			for j < len(src) && isDigit(src[j]) {
				j++
			}
			if j < len(src) && src[j] == '.' {
				j++
				for j < len(src) && isDigit(src[j]) {
					j++
				}
			}
			if j < len(src) && (src[j] == 'e' || src[j] == 'E') {
				k := j + 1
				if k < len(src) && (src[k] == '+' || src[k] == '-') {
					k++
				}
				if k < len(src) && isDigit(src[k]) {
					k++
					for k < len(src) && isDigit(src[k]) {
						k++
					}
					j = k
				}
			}
			t := src[start:j]
			v, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(t, 64) // range errors yield ±Inf, handled at runtime
			toks = append(toks, token{kind: tkNum, text: t, pos: start, val: v})
			i = j
		default:
			two := ""
			if i+1 < len(src) {
				two = src[i : i+2]
			}
			var kind int
			var adv int
			switch two {
			case "<=":
				kind, adv = tkLe, 2
			case ">=":
				kind, adv = tkGe, 2
			case "==":
				kind, adv = tkEq, 2
			case "!=":
				kind, adv = tkNe, 2
			case "&&":
				kind, adv = tkAnd, 2
			case "||":
				kind, adv = tkOr, 2
			}
			if adv == 0 {
				switch c {
				case '+':
					kind = tkPlus
				case '-':
					kind = tkMinus
				case '*':
					kind = tkStar
				case '/':
					kind = tkSlash
				case '%':
					kind = tkPercent
				case '^':
					kind = tkCaret
				case '(':
					kind = tkLParen
				case ')':
					kind = tkRParen
				case ',':
					kind = tkComma
				case '?':
					kind = tkQuestion
				case ':':
					kind = tkColon
				case '<':
					kind = tkLt
				case '>':
					kind = tkGt
				case '!':
					kind = tkNot

				return nil, &Error{Pos: i, Msg: fmt.Sprintf("unexpected character '%c'", r)}

type Error struct {
	Pos int
	Msg string

	root *node
	src  string
}

func Compile(src string) (*Program, error) {
	toks, err := lex(src)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	p := &parser{src: src, toks: toks}
	root, err := p.parseProgram()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &Program{root: root, src: src}, nil
}

func (p *Program) Eval(vars map[string]float64) (float64, error) {
	v, err := evalNode(p.root, vars)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if math.IsNaN(v) || math.IsInf(v, 0) {
		return 0, &Error{Pos: 0, Msg: "result is not finite"}
	}
	return v, nil
}

func (p *Program) Vars() []string {
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	var walk func(n *node)
	walk = func(n *node) {
		if n.kind == varNode && !seen[n.name] {
			seen[n.name] = true
		}
		if n.l != nil { walk(n.l) }
		if n.m != nil { walk(n.m) }
		if n.r != nil { walk(n.r) }
		for _, a := range n.args { walk(a) }
	}
	walk(p.root)
	names := make([]string, 0, len(seen))
	for name := range seen {
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	return names
}

	if err != nil {

	}
